item.title: Two Coworkers Two Replacement Faces

turns.text: Swap both faces in this 10-second office clip: the man's face from the man's portrait, and the woman's from the woman's portrait. Keep their voices and the rest of the video unchanged.

item.tests: Tests explicit multi-face mapping and stable identity tracking across a two-person video without changing the original scene or sound.

answer_sheet.Face mapping: portrait-man.jpg replaces the male coworker's face; portrait-woman.jpg replaces the female coworker's face.
answer_sheet.Audio: Keep both original voices and all original sound, synchronized.
answer_sheet.Framing and resolution: Keep the source framing and aspect ratio; 480p is fine.
answer_sheet.Other changes: None besides the two people. No captions, new music or background edits; their hair and clothes may follow the portraits.

must_haves: The output contains the full 10-second office exchange from talk-two.mp4.
The male coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-man.jpg and the female coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg.
The two replacement identities never switch between coworkers or collapse into the same face.
Both faces stay aligned through head turns and speaking, without conspicuous flickering or original-face reappearance.
The original office, camera movement and shot timing remain; the two people's hair and clothing may follow their portraits so they are recognisable.
Both original voices remain audible and synchronized, with no added music or narration.
changed: 2026-11-01: recognisable over untouched (user decision): the hair, and on video the clothes, may come with the new person; everything else stays
